title: 2D Spinless wallpaper groups: n0=0, e0=0
scope: Interacting relative stacking subgroup, with zero electric and thermal Hall response. Uniform neutral E8 is excluded explicitly. Phase and charge layers are displayed separately from stacking; their product is not assumed to be the stacking group.
row_rule: One group per row; one family, physical spin and n0 scope per file
